purpose: Re-evaluate the unchanged Stage 4A factorial on fresh seeds to remove the optimism of selecting and reporting on the same 12 seeds.
excluded_seed_note: Seed 2003 was run once to time the pipeline and its result was seen, so it is not part of this set.

criteria.C1_selection_stable: Applying rebound.run.select_rebound_variant to the fresh-seed rows selects the frozen variant.
criteria.C2_superiority: Paired difference in joint_normal_pass (frozen minus the alternative with the highest fresh-seed rate) has a seed-bootstrap 95% interval above 0.
criteria.C3_no_shrinkage: The original rate 8/12 lies inside the fresh-seed 95% interval of the frozen variant.

scope_note: Fresh seeds remove seed-selection optimism only. The benchmarks themselves (Gatev & Wichmann, Kita, Iwamuro, Nambu, Tachibana 2008, Bevan & Wilson) were used for selection and remain in-sample for any model built on this choice.
